headline: Nine-month growth strong, profit forecast raised
summary_short: Nine-month revenue rose 18.6% y/y to ¥99.6B and operating profit rose 12.7% to ¥23.4B. Net profit to owners grew 5.5% to ¥14.8B.
summary_long: Figures are cumulative for the nine months ended August 31, 2026, not the standalone quarter. Revenue was ¥99.6B (+18.6% y/y), operating profit ¥23.4B (+12.7%), and net profit to owners ¥14.8B (+5.5%). Total assets were ¥321.9B with an equity ratio of 34.9%. Per press-recap reports, the full-year revenue forecast was cut to ¥113.6B while the profit forecast and dividend (¥58 per share) were raised.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. Figures come from TipRanks and search-result recaps of the Oct 5, 2026 TDnet release (the IR PDF was unreadable). Revenue, profit and balance-sheet figures are nine-month cumulative. The EPS value is the shard's Yahoo earnings-chart figure, with no comparable prior; the quarterly-versus-cumulative basis is unverified and the share split may affect it.
